author: reek
body: Three crypto chapters that compiled and were never asked for an answer. A cipher checked only against its own inverse is checked against nothing, so the expected values here come from OUTSIDE: they were computed on the host by .NET, not recalled, and they agree with the published vectors.

author: reek
body: The stored result is threaded through a parameter rather than named at the top level, because a top-level binding is a definition and is rebuilt at every mention. Naming it cost four hashes instead of one and killed the guest with no output at all.
